T: Three bachelors. One baby. Zero clue.
D: Three party-loving bachelors suddenly have to look after a baby left on their doorstep.
P: Serve dessert when the guys sing the baby to sleep.
S: the surprise left outside the loft, note included

Golden fried sesame prawn toasts cut into triangles, served in a cloth-lined wicker basket with sweet chilli sauce. Blitz 300g peeled green prawns with 1 egg white, 1 tsp ginger, 1 spring onion and a pinch of salt. Spread on 6 slices of white bread, press in 4 tbsp sesame seeds, cut into triangles and fry at 180C until golden. Serve with sweet chilli sauce.

Crisp homemade parmesan breadsticks with a vivid roast beetroot and chickpea hummus for dunking. Mix 250g plain flour, 4g dried yeast, 1 tsp salt, 40g grated parmesan, 2 tbsp olive oil and 150ml warm water, knead 5 minutes, rest 30 minutes. Roll into 24 thin sticks and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until crisp. Blitz 250g cooked beetroot, 400g drained chickpeas, 2 tbsp tahini, 1 garlic clove, lemon juice and 3 tbsp olive oil until smooth.
Thin-sliced day-old bagels brushed with oil, baked crisp at 180C for 12 minutes, with cream cheese whipped with chives and lemon.
M: Sirloin seared and sliced thin, onions caramelised for 30 minutes, Swiss melted on top, horseradish mayo on toasted sourdough.
Bachelor pad sweet and sour pork
the classic bachelor takeaway, before baby Mary turns up

Double-fried crisp pork in a glossy sweet and sour sauce with pineapple, capsicum and onion, over steamed rice. Cut 600g pork shoulder into 3cm pieces, toss with 1 tbsp soy and 1 egg, then coat in 80g potato starch. Fry at 170C for 4 minutes, rest, then again at 190C for 1 minute. Stir-fry 1 capsicum and 1 onion for 2 minutes. Add 200g pineapple pieces, 80ml tomato sauce, 60ml rice vinegar, 50g sugar and 100ml water, thicken with 1 tsp cornflour. Toss the pork through and serve with rice.
W: smooth, no lumps, Peter reads her the boxing news while it cools

Heat 500ml milk with a split vanilla pod, pour onto 4 yolks whisked with 60g sugar and 2 tbsp cornflour, return and stir until thick. Heat 500ml milk with a split vanilla bean until steaming. Whisk 4 egg yolks with 60g caster sugar and 2 tbsp cornflour, pour on the hot milk, then return to the pan and stir over low heat until thick. Serve warm, or chill with plastic pressed on the surface.
K: the 3am feeds, test it on your wrist first

Cold milk shaken with bourbon, vanilla and a little sugar until frothy, served over ice with fresh nutmeg on top. Shake 160ml bourbon, 400ml cold full cream milk, 40ml sugar syrup and half a tsp vanilla extract with ice for 15 seconds until frothy. Strain into 4 ice-filled glasses and grate nutmeg over the top. For a no-booze version, leave out the bourbon and add a spoon of honey.
